dct_description_sm: Data was collected to understand community responses to the changing availability of barren-ground caribou, in terms of hunting and food-sharing.  This involved looking at the history of community hunts, and comparing sharing networks between a community hunt and a series of household hunts.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Human-wildlife relationships
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Hunting
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Resource management strategies
Natural sciences -> Bluenose West caribou herd
dct_title_s: Interview and workshop transcripts from harvesters in Fort Good Hope NWT about community hunts, barren-ground caribou hunts, and food-sharing practices, 2009-2010
